capabilities: Detect the vocabulary table in a note and track rows by UUID
Schedule spaced reviews with configurable intervals and grace windows
Show a review sidebar grouping overdue, due, and pending-mastery words
Archive mastered words and reactivate them on demand
Regenerate a plain-text word list for mobile widgets
disambiguation: Not a sync tool for Microsoft Word documents; "word" refers to vocabulary entries in a table.
extras: Documentation and settings are partly written in Chinese (e.g. 原始单词表, 单词查看); the README mentions a diagnostics log and autosave copy but no screenshots or troubleshooting section.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track spaced review dates for vocabulary stored in a Markdown table.
summary: Vocabulary review manager that detects a Markdown word table and schedules spaced reviews with a sidebar, archiving, and a plain-text mobile list.
